##### Project general facts

The Tides by AMIS is a calm, fluid residential building where contemporary architecture flows effortlessly with its waterfront setting. Horizontal lines, wide balconies and panoramic glazing define the exterior. The building rises above a ground floor and two podium levels to eight residential floors and a rooftop, offering fully furnished one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments with layouts that include a study or a maid's room, together with three-level four-bedroom townhouses at ground level.

Amenities are spread across the podium and the rooftop. Residents are welcomed into a lobby with a lounge, and can stay active in the fitness centre, the CrossFit zone and on the jogging track. A green park, a zen garden, a meditation area, a yoga deck, a bocce court, a barbecue area, a multipurpose room and a kids' play area complete the podium, while the rooftop features an infinity pool, a kids' pool, a splash pad, lounge areas and an outdoor cinema.

Interiors are styled in a neutral palette with open layouts, built-in storage and large windows that bring in natural light and frame views of the sea and the island. Living and dining areas flow onto wide balconies, while bedrooms offer calm, private retreats. Spatial planning emphasises functionality and comfort, and townhouses add generous family space over three levels. Homes are delivered fully furnished, allowing residents to move in with ease and enjoy island living straight away.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Islands is a waterfront destination off the coast of Deira, made up of islands with beaches, marinas, resorts, parks and promenades. The area offers a relaxed island lifestyle with open sea views, beachfront hotels, retail and dining, landscaped green spaces and cycling and walking routes, just across the water from the historic heart of the city.

The Gold Souq metro station, Deira, Dubai Creek and the Gold Souk are a short drive away, and the Infinity Bridge and Al Khaleej Road connect the islands with the city centre. Dubai International Airport, Downtown Dubai and Business Bay are within comfortable driving distance, while schools, clinics and supermarkets serve families across the islands and in neighbouring Deira.

Dubai Islands is a freehold destination open to international buyers and one of the most actively developed waterfront areas in Dubai. Beach access, island living and proximity to the airport and the historic city centre attract both end users and investors. Strong demand for furnished waterfront homes and holiday rentals supports attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners and investors alike.
